_comment: 1.26 Estate Projects: long projects in the village square once the Village Festival has happened (all six rooms). Each stage is a restoration room (ids estate_<project>_<stage>; bundles like the manor's, minStar 2 = gold-star only) and opens when the stage before it is finished and the player has reached the project's `opensAt`. Rewards are read in src/systems/Estate.ts; the last stage hands out the project's `finale` (a model for the farm and a letter).

projects.name: The Clock Tower
projects.about: The square had a clock tower once. Bram is going to build it again, with your help, bell and all.

finale.title: It chimes!
finale.body:
{farmer},

Hear that? That's the square's clock. Right on time, every hour, for the next hundred years.

I put a little model of it in your storage. Made it from the offcuts. Don't make a fuss.

Bram

stages.name: Foundations
stages.about: Where the old clock tower stood there is only a ring of cracked stones. Bram wants it back, and he wants it done properly: deep foundations, good iron, and lunch.

letter.title: Good stone
letter.body:
{farmer},

Foundations are in. Deep enough to hold a mountain. Probably too deep. I don't care.

Next, the tower.

Bram

stages.name: The Tower
stages.about: Up it goes, brick by glazed brick. The crew works through the cold mornings, so hot drinks are not optional.

reward.text: The tower stands over the square.

letter.title: Taller than the bakery
letter.body:
{farmer},

The tower is up. Taller than Rosa's chimney, which she says is showing off. It is.

Bram

stages.name: The Clockwork
stages.about: Hazel found the old clockmaker's drawings in the village records. Gears of iron and gold, oiled with beeswax and honey, the way they did it a hundred years ago.

letter.title: Tick, tock
letter.body:
Dear {farmer},

I stood under the tower for an hour this afternoon just listening to it tick. Bram pretended not to be pleased. Bram was very pleased.

With love,
Hazel

stages.name: The Bell and the Face
stages.about: Last of all, a bell for the top and a face everyone in the valley can read. Then the whole square gets to hear it.
stages.rebuilds: the bell and the clock face

reward.text: The Clock Tower keeps the real time and chimes on the hour, and a model of it is yours for your farm.

projects.name: The Lighthouse
projects.about: The old lighthouse on the point has been dark for forty years. Light it again and the boats will come more often.

finale.title: The light is lit
finale.body:
Ahoy {farmer},

We lit her at dusk. The whole valley was out on the point, and when the beam swung round the first time, everyone cheered. I may have cheered loudest.

The boats will see it from far off now. Expect visitors more often.

There's a little model of her in your storage. Thank you, {farmer}.

Old Tom

stages.name: The Rocks
stages.about: Out on the point the old lighthouse is a stump on the rocks. Old Tom remembers it lit every night of his fishing life, and he would like to see it lit again before he hangs up his oars.

reward.text: The footings are set on the rocks.

letter.title: Steady on the rocks
letter.body:
Ahoy {farmer},

The footings are set and the sea didn't take a single one. I've seen storms take worse.

Old Tom

stages.name: The White Tower
stages.about: A tall white tower with a red band, so ships see it by day as well as by night.

reward.text: The tower stands white and red on the point.

letter.title: Red and white
letter.body:
Ahoy {farmer},

The tower's up, painted white with a red band, the way she always was. Pip painted the band. Mostly on the band.

Old Tom

stages.name: The Lamp Room
stages.about: The lamp room at the top: glass from the creek's quartz, a lens polished with pearls, and a good supply of oil and candles for the long nights.

reward.text: The lamp room is glazed and ready.

letter.title: The lens
letter.body:
Dear {farmer},

I helped polish the lens today. When the sun came through it, it threw a rainbow across the whole bay. I need to paint that.

Juniper

stages.name: The Light
stages.about: One last thing: light it. The whole valley will walk out to the point to watch.

reward.text: The Lighthouse shines every night, and Boat Visitors call three days a week instead of two. A model of it is yours for your farm.

projects.name: The Observatory
projects.about: On the hill behind the manor stand the stones of an old observatory. Juniper wants to paint the night sky through a real telescope.

finale.title: A star for you
finale.body:
Dear {farmer},

Last night I looked through the telescope until my neck ached. There's a little star just above the Elder Oak that nobody has named, so I named it after you.

Come up on any clear night and look for it. There's a model of the observatory in your storage.

Juniper

stages.name: The Old Stones
stages.about: The old footings are cracked and overgrown. Clear them and lay a new base.

reward.text: The base is laid on the hill.

letter.title: On the hill
letter.body:
Dear {farmer},

The base is down! I sat on it at sunset with my sketchbook. Next, the tower.

Juniper

stages.name: The Round Tower
stages.about: A round stone tower with a winding stair, tall enough to see over the trees.

reward.text: The round tower stands on the hill.

letter.title: Up and up
letter.body:
Dear {farmer},

The tower is up and the stair winds all the way round. My knees will be very fit.

Juniper

stages.name: The Copper Dome
stages.about: A dome that turns, with a slit that opens to the sky.

reward.text: The copper dome turns on its rail.

letter.title: It turns!
letter.body:
Dear {farmer},

The dome turns! Bram greased the rail himself and it spins with one finger.

Juniper

stages.name: The Great Telescope
stages.about: The telescope itself: brass, glass ground by hand, and star crystals to fine-tune the lens.

reward.text: The observatory is finished: look through the telescope on any clear night for a small gift from the stars.

projects.name: The Windmill Mill
projects.about: The old mill on the west point lost its sails in a storm long ago. Rosa wants it turning again for her bakery.

finale.title: The sails are turning
finale.body:
Dear {farmer},

The sails turned for the first time this morning and I cried into my apron. Flour from our own mill, after all these years!

Your Feed Mill and your bakery will be quicker from now on. There's a model of the mill in your storage.

Rosa

stages.name: The Mill Base
stages.about: Clear the rubble and rebuild the round base of the mill.

reward.text: The base of the mill is rebuilt.

letter.title: A good start
letter.body:
Dear {farmer},

The base is done and it's as solid as my bread. Well, my good bread.

Rosa

stages.name: The White Tower
stages.about: A tall white tower with room for the millstones inside.

reward.text: The white tower of the mill stands again.

letter.title: White as flour
letter.body:
Dear {farmer},

The tower is whitewashed and you can see it from my bakery window.

Rosa

stages.name: The Cap
stages.about: A thatched cap that turns the sails into the wind.

reward.text: The cap is on and turns to the wind.

letter.title: It turns to the wind
letter.body:
Dear {farmer},

The cap is on! Hazel says the thatch is the neatest she has ever seen.

Rosa

stages.name: The Sails
stages.about: Four great sails of canvas on oak frames.

reward.text: The Windmill Mill turns: Feed Mill and Bakery jobs take 15% less time.
